compiled_verification.scope: Private source ownership is restored without inventing a native entry for the Planar Chaos base inline fragment. Three physical private helpers bind one-to-one by C CU/name through the existing reccmp binding routine; the two time-counter callbacks are distinct. Four native/current Timecrafting assignments select its local callback and never the Time Spiral copy. All three card bodies are unchanged. Native and rebuilt DWARF show compiler-selected inlining, not source-declared inline. Strict CFGs still differ for all six selected entries; no full instruction, callee or gameplay equivalence claimed. Full report/setup refresh deferred. A header rebuild was followed by an incremental rebuild after removing the initial explicit inline annotations; only the final plain-static source/build is accepted.
